sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop): a long, stalking run, the greatsword trailing behind him with its blade up to the upper left, the LEGS CHANGING OVER
sheets.weapons: THE GREATSWORD goes where the pale figure has it, frame by frame (image 3 shows it in colour): ONE teal crystal greatsword, WHOLE and STRAIGHT, as large as in image 1 - the hilt, the hooked crystal crossguard, the long blade - in his hands, on his shoulder, raised, swept low or planted as the pale figure holds it; never bent, cut, shortened or a second sword. Only the sword: no black mist, no souls, no sword trails, no glow round it.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) planted straight down under his hips, its foot flat on the ground; the FAR leg (the darker one) kicked up and back behind him, bent, its foot high off the ground. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) carries him and the FAR leg comes forward, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one) carries him and the NEAR leg comes forward - frames 1 and 5 must look different: a different leg planted, the other one kicked back. Never the same leg in front in every frame (Senna's first run did that, and Talon's: 「走路没有换腿」).
